node: Program ROI, outcomes data, gainful-employment compliance, and credential transparency
summary: This pass expands the universe around the underappreciated data/compliance chokepoint in education: proving program value through debt, earnings, placement, skills, and credential outcomes. The strongest public-market mappings are not only schools exposed to gainful-employment and financial-value-transparency rules, but also data rails and software platforms that help institutions connect student records, financial data, workforce outcomes, skills, and verified credentials. This is research support only and not a buy/sell recommendation.
